question: Which of the following awards is NOT sponsored by the Madhya Pradesh government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tagore Ratna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tagore Ratna** is not sponsored by the Madhya Pradesh government.
 
• It is an award that typically relates to the legacy of Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• The Madhya Pradesh government sponsors awards such as the Devi Ahilyabai Award, Kabirra Kumar Samman, and Tulsidas Samman.
 
• These awards are generally given to individuals who have made significant contributions in various fields such as literature, arts, and social work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devi Ahilyabai Award**:

 
 
• This award is given by the Madhya Pradesh government to honor women who have made significant contributions to society.
 
• It is named after Devi Ahilyabai Holkar, the queen of the Maratha Malwa kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Kabirra Kumar Samman**:
 
 
• This award is presented by the Madhya Pradesh government to recognize contributions in the field of folk music and arts.
 
• It is named after the famous poet-saint Kabir.
 
 
 
• **Tulsidas Samman**:
 
 
• This award honors individuals who have made significant contributions to literature, particularly in the context of Hindi literature.
 
• It is named after Tulsidas, the acclaimed poet and author of the Ramcharitmanas.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh Government Awards**:
 
 
• The Madhya Pradesh government sponsors various awards to recognize achievements in fields like literature, arts, and social work.
 
• These awards aim to encourage and promote cultural and social contributions in the state.
